cases.normal: dependent stop/reap/cleanup precedes prerequisite; all four durable phase records per unit
cases.split: termination retains empty frozen boundary until separately requested release
cases.premature: release cannot kill or remove a live/still-unobserved boundary
cases.staged: stop/cleanup without a fabricated successful start
cases.exited_descendant: dead leader is not sufficient; actual C1 descendant termination observed
cases.identity: changed handle/copied step/session/registry rejects ordinary authority
cases.issuer_loss: cleanup-only original C1 can release tree; normal/direct-child uncertainty remains explicit
cases.persistence: append/flush failure or real storage lock triggers cleanup independent of new writes
cases.bounded_continue: failed unit does not prevent later owned cleanup under original end
cases.repeat: same scope/reason returns retained facts; changed reason rejects
cases.cancel_conflict: cancel independent of mutation locks; conflict nonblocking
